title: Bounded coherent cohomology of a perfect complex on a Noetherian scheme
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth] (locally Noetherian and quasi-compact), and $E$ an object of $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. If $E$ is perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], then there exist integers $a,b$ such that $H^i(E)=0$ for $i<a$ or $i>b$, and every $H^i(E)$ is coherent [pqf-def-coherent].

proof.text: Choose the strictly perfect neighbourhoods supplied by [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Refine by affine opens and by finite free trivializations of the finitely many projective terms. Over these Noetherian affine rings kernels, images and quotients of the finite module terms are finite. Exact restriction computes the local cohomology as these subquotients. Thus each local cohomology sheaf is quasi-coherent of finite type, hence coherent by [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth]. Coherence glues by [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-module-local-on-open-cover].

Quasi-compactness selects a finite subcover. Take a minimum of the lower term bounds and a maximum of the upper term bounds, using 0,0 for an empty cover. Outside this interval each restricted cohomology sheaf is zero. Sheaf section extensionality makes the global cohomology sheaf zero. This gives the claimed bounds.

lean.statement:
theorem perfect_bounded_coherent_cohomology (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hE : IsPerfect X E) :
    (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E)) ∧
    (∀ i : ℤ, RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E))
